BIBLE-2tj: as of 2026-08-12 commit 215113a. 20 content files + 7 ADRs. STAGE 14 done: 00n-torah-fulfilled-and-what-changed.md (Matthew 5:17-18 as control on Matt 24:35).

KEY MOVES: Two 'untils' (heos an parelthe ho ouranos kai he ge / heos an panta genetai) — relationship recorded UNDETERMINED with 4 possibilities tabled (coterminous / B-defines-A / independent / merism), none selected. katalyo explicitly negated by Yeshua; pleroo read against Matthew's OWN prior usage (1:22, 2:15, 2:17, 4:14) = Scripture reaching intended realization. Neither 'fulfill=terminate' nor 'fulfill=nothing changes' is in the verb. CJB translates pleroo as 'complete'.

MELCHIZEDEK earned entry from Stage 9 bookmark: Hebrews 7:11-12 argues from Psalm 110 — from the Tanakh itself, not against it. LEXICAL BRAKE: metathesis/metatithemi ranges from Enoch's TRANSFER (Heb 11:5) to REMOVAL of the shaken (Heb 12:27); ESV/RVR1960 'change', CJB 'transformation', none 'abolition' — word opens range, settles nothing.

Jeremiah 31 blocks BOTH reductions at once: covenant explicitly 'not like' Sinai AND Torah written on hearts, made with Israel+Judah. CJB versification offset recorded (ESV 31:31 = CJB 31:30), same category as Zechariah 2:6.

HEBREWS 8:13 CASHED (was bookmarked at Stage 13) — becoming obsolete/growing old/ready to vanish = transition in progress. Heb 8:4 + 10:1-2 describe operating system in present tense. SUBSTANTIAL BRAKE: pre-AD-70 dating is INFERENCE not statement. Three counter-considerations recorded, one (other writers using present tense post-70) flagged explicitly UNVERIFIED — must not be asserted until primary sources checked. Status: PERMITS not establishes.

INTRATEXTUAL DATUM (checkable): Matt 5:18 heos an PANTA GENETAI vs Matt 24:34 heos an PANTA TAUTA GENETAI — differ only by tauta; plus shared parelthe. Establishes a reason to ask, NOT an answer. Luke 21:32 Greek flagged UNCHECKED, must not be cited yet (Solomon incident is the standing reminder).

NEW GLOSSARY: Intratextuality (within one author's work) vs intertextuality (between texts). Stronger in one respect (same author), narrower in another (Matthew's usage != hearers' understanding).

NEW FORMAL RULE: Category Collapse Test — check whether a question names one thing or several packaged as one, BEFORE answering. Runs FIRST; malformed questions can't be rescued downstream. Rule order now: Category Collapse -> Intertextual Priority -> Audience Continuity -> Anti-Replacement.

SIX-WAY DISTINCTION (major structural finding): Torah / Mosaic covenant / Levitical priesthood / Temple / sacrificial administration / moral commandments overlap enormously but are NOT interchangeable. 'Is the Law abolished?' is at least 8 questions wearing one coat.

UNRESOLVED COST RECORDED HONESTLY: if 'all is accomplished' landed in the first century, Matthew 5:19 must mean something afterward. The easy exit ('only transitional') is exactly the protective exception this project refuses opponents — so it doesn't grant itself one. Open question 15.

Heart-circumcision traced INTO Torah: Deut 10:16, Deut 30:6 (same chapter as 30:4's 'uttermost parts of heaven'), Jer 4:4. Paul didn't invent it.

Acts paid a dividend — the six-way distinction was watched being wrestled in Acts 15, not built theoretically. First real payoff of ADR-0007's dual architecture.

NEXT STAGE: The What-Changed Table. 14 rows (covenant, priesthood, sacrifice, Temple, circumcision, Torah, Sabbath, food, festivals, moral commandments, Israel, Gentiles, Spirit, access to Yahweh) x columns (before Messiah / prophetic expectation / Yeshua / apostolic interpretation / explicitly changed? / explicitly retained? / unresolved). 'Explicitly changed' and 'explicitly retained' are NOT complements — a row can be neither, and 'Unresolved' is a legitimate final answer. Populate from Scripture only; label the picture afterward. Skeleton at 00n section 16.
